2607.17843.title: Mobius Learning: Cyclic Depth Folding in Transformers
2607.17843.paper_summary: Transformer-based language models organize computation along an ordered depth axis, where shallow and deep blocks often develop distinct representational roles. We challenge the conventional view that these roles must remain tied to a block's position in the ordered sequence. We introduce Mobius Learning, a training architecture based on cyclic depth folding, in which different data streams follow cyclically shifted block orders. The same block group is therefore applied early in the block sequence for some data streams and late for others, so it is optimized in both shallow and deep roles, a phenomenon we call depth-role superposition. Surprisingly, in four-worker experiments with a modded GPT-2 small (124M) model trained on 2.5B FineWeb tokens using Muon, Mobius Learning achieves lower validation loss than a fixed-order looped Transformer at larger numbers of Transformer block-sequence passes. This counterintuitive result shows that a block group need not remain confined to one fixed shallow or deep role within the block sequence and opens a new design space based on cyclic depth folding. Crucially, this structure makes Mobius Learning particularly well suited to memory-constrained distributed training: raw training data remain local, while each worker stores one block group rather than the complete Transformer block stack.
2607.17843.paper_summary_zh: Transformer 基於的語言模型沿著有序的深度軸組織計算，其中淺層和深層區塊通常發展出不同的表徵角色。<lb/>我們挑戰傳統觀點，即這些角色必須與區塊在有序序列中的位置保持關聯。<lb/>我們引入 Mobius Learning，一種基於循環深度摺疊的訓練架構，其中不同的數據流遵循循環偏移的區塊順序。<lb/>因此，相同的區塊組在某些數據流中早期應用於區塊序列，而在其他數據流中則晚期應用，使其在淺層和深層角色中都得到優化，這一現象我們稱之為深度角色重疊。<lb/>令人驚訝的是，在四個工作者的實驗中，使用 Muon 訓練的經過修改的 GPT-2 small (124M) 模型在 2.5B FineWeb 令牌上，Mobius Learning 在較多的 Transformer 區塊序列通過中實現了比固定順序循環 Transformer 更低的驗證損失。<lb/>這一反直覺的結果顯示，區塊組不必局限於區塊序列中的一個固定淺層或深層角色，並為基於循環深度摺疊的新設計空間開啟了可能性。<lb/>關鍵是，這種結構使 Mobius Learning 特別適合於記憶受限的分佈式訓練：原始訓練數據保持在本地，而每個工作者存儲一個區塊組，而不是完整的 Transformer 區塊堆疊。
